learn.title: Learn
learn.subtitle: Patterns that solve any board
learn.intro: Five short lessons. Together they clear any board.

status.start: Start a level, then chase the lights down.
status.chase: Row {row}: tap under each lit light.
status.match: Tap the ringed top lights, then chase again.
status.progress: Finish the ringed top taps, then chase again.
status.nomatch: This bottom row can't be cleared. Restart and chase again.
status.rectBottom: Only the bottom row is left. Its top-row taps must be worked out: Hint shows one, then chase again.

reference.shaped: Chasing needs a full rectangle. Here, find a lit plus, T or L and tap its centre.

shapes.title: One tap, five lights
shapes.summary: Spot the shape a tap makes, then tap its centre.
steps: A tap flips the light you touch and the four around it: a plus of five.
At an edge a tap makes a T of four. In a corner, an L of three.
See one of these shapes? Tap its centre and it goes dark.
Your turn. Each board needs one tap: find the centre.

order.title: Order doesn't matter
order.summary: Taps cancel out and can go in any order.
steps: Tap the same light twice and nothing has changed. The second tap undoes the first.
These two pluses overlap. Tap the ringed centres in either order: same board.
So an answer is a set of lights, each tapped once. Order doesn't matter.
Your turn. Each board takes two or three taps.

chase.title: Chase the lights down
chase.summary: Push every light down to the bottom row.
steps: Start at the top row. Under every lit light, tap the light below it.
Do the same for each row below. The lights move down: this is chasing.
Sometimes lights are left in the bottom row. The next lesson clears them.
Your turn: chase from the top. Assist rings the next tap.

bottom-row.title: Clear the bottom row
bottom-row.summary: Every top-row light has an echo.
steps: After a chase, only the bottom row is left. There is nothing below it to tap.
Tap one top-row light, then chase down. The bottom row it leaves is its echo.
Your bottom row is an echo. Tap that top light and chase again: the echo lands twice and cancels.
Some rows are two echoes stacked. Tap both top lights; where the echoes overlap, they cancel.
Your turn: chase, cancel the echo, chase again. Assist rings each tap.

shortest.title: The shortest answer
shortest.summary: Every board has four answers. Par is the shortest.
steps: Tap all the ringed lights and nothing changes: every light flips an even number of times.
Add these taps to an answer and you get another answer. Par is the shortest.
Your turn. Try to solve it in par.

echo-more.title: Echoes, deeper
echo-more.summary: Rules to remember, how an echo forms, and a drill.
steps: Five rules cover every bottom row.
How an echo forms: pick a light and follow the chase, row by row.
Whose echo is this? Tap the top-row lights that cancel it.

echo.pick: Pick a top-row light to see its echo.
echo.caption: {name} echoes as {row}

rules.three: Three in a row: tap above the middle one.
rules.allButMiddle: All but the middle: tap the top middle.
rules.pairLoner: A pair and a loner: tap the top corner over the dark end.
rules.corners: Both corners: tap a top corner and its neighbour.
rules.gap: Two with a gap: tap above one, and the corner past the other.
rules.mirror: Each rule works mirrored, left for right.

drill.prompt: Tap the top-row lights that cancel this row.
drill.scoreLine: Rows you missed come back sooner.
drill.intro: Ten rows. Rows you miss come back sooner.

derive.rule: Each row's taps: the row above, spread one step left and right, then cancelled against the row two above.
derive.tip: Not sure? Tap a guess and chase. If it's wrong, tap it again and chase: its echo cancels.
